asset_policy.portable: Safe to copy and reuse without the author's private runtime.
asset_policy.adapter: Target-specific guidance staged for manual review; registration is never implicit.
asset_policy.case-study: Evidence and design narrative only; not an installable runtime.
asset_policy.external: Linked project or contract; no runtime is copied into this repository.
asset_policy.excluded: Private, generated, vendor-owned, credential-bearing, or unsafe material.

source_map.treatment: behavioral-patterns-only; machine paths and registrations removed
link-and-case-study-only; runtime, logs, databases, and generated harvests are not copied
link-and-contract-fixture-only; runtimes remain in their own projects
do not redistribute managed files, private sessions, credentials, or raw transcripts
sanitized behavioral patterns from owned authored repositories and first-party skill sources; private source paths remain undistributed
behavioral mining only; concrete manifests, live mappings, agents, commands, audit evidence, and unresolved conflicts remain private

assets.title: Research Domain Writing
assets.summary: Research -> packet -> draft -> QA -> style workflow for domain-specific writing.

editorial.why: Turn a domain-writing request into a researched, cited, reviewed deliverable instead of an unsupported draft.
editorial.use_when: Use when factual grounding, source provenance, and a repeatable writing pipeline matter.
editorial.avoid_when: Avoid for casual copy edits or tasks that do not need research and source-backed claims.

assets.title: Repo-aware context routing
assets.summary: A repository-first context selection discipline that keeps instructions, source maps, and live truth separate.

editorial.why: Give an agent the right repository identity and context without collapsing instructions, source maps, and live state together.
editorial.use_when: Use before repository work where nested guidance, freshness, and ownership boundaries affect the answer.
editorial.avoid_when: Avoid for self-contained tasks that do not depend on repository state or local instructions.

install.manual_review: Review the repository identity, freshness, and minimum-context routing contract before enabling it for a host.
